summary: A firewalled WNBA section that processes observed multi-book market prices only. It has NO model and produces NO forecasts, edges, or EV — none can exist without WNBA data this system does not have.

governance.R1_never_invent: module structurally emits model_prob/model_edge/model_ev = null and the selftest fails if any is non-null; every probability is labeled MARKET-IMPLIED
governance.firewall: data/wnba/** and harness/wnba_market.py are isolated from the MLB engine, model_registry, forecast_registry, policy_gate, and healthcheck. No WNBA number reaches the MLB gate (0/100), forecasts, or ledgers.
governance.supersede_rule: official box/result tier-1 supersedes; user positions user-authoritative (same as MLB)

descriptive_context_omitted.attempted: WNBA team records / standings (Aug 8 2026) via WebSearch, to sanity-check the lines
descriptive_context_omitted.result: source returned implausible/stale figures (e.g. '5-2' records in August, inconsistent across teams)
descriptive_context_omitted.decision: OMITTED rather than recorded — per R1, unreliable data is not laundered into the section. Records/form can be added later from a verified source (basketball-reference/WNBA.com box history), clearly labeled DESCRIPTIVE_CONTEXT_ONLY, never as a model input.

to_promote_to_a_real_model: ingest WNBA results history (dates, home/away, scores) — none on disk
team ratings (four-factor/possession), injuries, rest/back-to-backs, star minutes
fit + rolling date-ordered OOS calibration, graded through a WNBA forecast registry parallel to the MLB one
only then may model probabilities/edges/EV be emitted — and only as DIAGNOSTIC until a clean prospective sample clears a pre-registered gate
